c: Instead of bouncing on enemies 3 times before using up their own pierce like other weapons, Death Spiral bounces off the edges of the screen once; Flash Arrow and Millionaire 3 times; and Carréllo 3 more times. They already have nearly infinite Pierce and benefits more from staying on screen longer.
The drones' projectiles of Prototype A, B, and C gains +1 bounce instead of 3, while their main weapon will not benefit.
